title: Simultaneous Residue-Class Selection in Prescribed-Difference Packings
summary: A family $\mathcal F$ of finite subsets of $\mathbb Z$ is packed into $[N]$ if suitable integer translates of its members are pairwise disjoint subsets of $[N]$. We study two prescribed-difference packing problems of Alon, Dębski, Grytczuk and Przybyło for the arithmetic progressions $A_d=\{d,2d,\ldots,\lfloor n/d\rfloor d\}$ and $B_d=\{d,2d,\ldots,nd\}$. Let $m(n)$ and $M(n)$ denote the corresponding minimum packing lengths, with subscripts indicating restrictions on the admissible differences, and let $\mathcal P(x)$ denote the set of primes at most $x$.
